review.notes: Every subobjective from the official page last updated May 5, 2026 is mapped to a production dependency, implementation boundary, evidence artifact, failure action, or recovery path. Three scenarios, eight independent labs, and 36 original knowledge checks cover ACR/Tasks, App Service, Container Apps/KEDA, AKS, Cosmos DB/vector/change feed, PostgreSQL/pgvector, Managed Redis, Service Bus, Event Grid, Functions, identity, Key Vault, App Configuration, OpenTelemetry and KQL. All 55 cited URLs are exact catalog entries: 51 were reachable and four commercial-provider pages were access-blocked; none was missing or broken. The guide records no current Microsoft Practice Assessment and the exact Azure Cache for Redis retirement transition. No upcoming exam blueprint change or retirement was announced.

findings.title: Managed Redis clustering conversion documentation conflicts
findings.evidence: Creation guide prohibits changes after creation; REST permits update from NoCluster with constraints.
findings.recommendation: Keep the support limitation visible pending authoritative evidence.

findings.title: Exam languages expanded
findings.evidence: Exam now lists thirteen languages.
findings.recommendation: Correct profile; distinguish twelve course languages.
findings.resolution: Correct profile; distinguish twelve course languages.

findings.title: Prior self-study duration cannot be reverified
findings.evidence: Short current course page exposes five days but not prior nine-path/32h4 total.
findings.recommendation: Remove current-total assertion and label editorial study budget.
findings.resolution: Remove current-total assertion and label editorial study budget.

findings.title: Legacy ACR roles fail in ABAC mode
findings.evidence: Legacy roles not honored; repository roles and task source identity required.
findings.recommendation: Add role/mode matrix, catalog scope and source-auth guidance.
findings.resolution: Add role/mode matrix, catalog scope and source-auth guidance.

findings.title: Sidecar apps use different port/pull configuration
findings.evidence: Legacy Docker app settings do not configure sitecontainers.
findings.recommendation: Distinguish models before troubleshooting.

findings.title: Example lacked required workload-identity pod label
findings.evidence: Token injection needs use=true pod label and configured ServiceAccount.
findings.recommendation: Correct manifest and document independent identity prerequisites.
findings.resolution: Correct manifest and document independent identity prerequisites.

findings.title: Vector dimensions and index thresholds affect behavior
findings.evidence: 505/4096 dimension limits; approximate indexes need 1000 vectors.
findings.recommendation: Add limits and policy-change/recall caveats.

findings.title: Python does not expose processor library
findings.evidence: Processor unsupported in Python SDK.
findings.recommendation: Separate .NET/Java processor, Python managed trigger and pull ownership.
findings.resolution: Separate .NET/Java processor, Python managed trigger and pull ownership.

findings.title: Trigger failure does not imply automatic application retry
findings.evidence: Default unhandled Cosmos-trigger failure is not retried.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit retry policy, batch idempotency and durable reconciliation.
findings.resolution: Add explicit retry policy, batch idempotency and durable reconciliation.

findings.title: Filtered ANN can under-return
findings.evidence: Post-filter candidate limitation and iterative scan version boundary.
findings.recommendation: Add authorized exact baseline and recall worksheet.
findings.resolution: Add authorized exact baseline and recall worksheet.

findings.title: Stale Redis customer cutoff uncorroborated
findings.evidence: Current FAQ retains retirement deadlines but not prior cutoff assertion.
findings.recommendation: Remove unsupported date and keep verified retirement boundaries.
findings.resolution: Remove unsupported date and keep verified retirement boundaries.

findings.title: Redis vector search needs compatible provisioning
findings.evidence: RediSearch requires Enterprise clustering, NoEviction and creation-time module.
findings.recommendation: Add policy/client/memory requirements and migration lab.
findings.resolution: Add policy/client/memory requirements and migration lab.

findings.title: Settlement can fail after durable work
findings.evidence: Lock loss prevents valid settlement after side effect.
findings.recommendation: Separate successful processing from completion failure; add syntax-valid async pattern.
findings.resolution: Separate successful processing from completion failure; add syntax-valid async pattern.

findings.title: Dedup and legacy retirement have bounded scopes
findings.evidence: History, tier and partition identity differ; Sept 30 legacy SDK/SBMP deadline.
findings.recommendation: Add scoped dedup contract and package/protocol inventory.
findings.resolution: Add scoped dedup contract and package/protocol inventory.

findings.title: Event Grid retry differs by destination/mode
findings.evidence: Basic webhook nonretry codes and response/TTL limits.
findings.recommendation: Add mode-specific failure table guidance.

findings.title: Runtime and plan retirement dates differ
findings.evidence: Linux v3 stops after September 30 2026; Linux Consumption plan retires 2028.
findings.recommendation: Separate deadlines and HTTP/Flex downstream constraints.
findings.resolution: Separate deadlines and HTTP/Flex downstream constraints.

findings.title: Secret publication does not immediately refresh consumers
findings.evidence: Versionless reference can cache for 24 hours; pinned version persists.
findings.recommendation: Add refresh sequence, slot distinction and timing worksheet.
findings.resolution: Add refresh sequence, slot distinction and timing worksheet.

findings.title: Refresh interval does not start background polling
findings.evidence: Provider requires explicit refresh calls.
findings.recommendation: Add invocation and sentinel ordering requirement.
findings.resolution: Add invocation and sentinel ordering requirement.

findings.title: KQL row counts were labeled as full request totals
findings.evidence: Sampling weights and trace/metric distinction change interpretation.
findings.recommendation: Label sampled rows/percentiles and add weighted denominator example.
findings.resolution: Label sampled rows/percentiles and add weighted denominator example.

findings.title: Migration can reduce load before moving services
findings.evidence: Case study identifies redundant L1/remote reads, reconnect and rollback issues.
findings.recommendation: Add bounded original engineering worksheet; no savings guarantee.
findings.resolution: Add bounded original engineering worksheet; no savings guarantee.
